## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for every new behaviour
- [ ] All CI checks pass locally (`make check`)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or magic numbers
- [ ] Type hints added for every new function/method
- [ ] Docstrings added for every new public function/class
- [ ] `requirements.txt` updated if new packages were added
